paragraphs.text: Nogi is a legendary kobold shaman from an unknown plane.

Nogi is a fiery Kobold Shaman, devoted to the worship and service of dragons . His small, red-skinned frame is adorned with ritualistic clothing and draconic symbols. He carries a drum adorned with dragon claws and painted symbols, which he beats with a mallet marked with a dragon skull, symbolizing his deep reverence for these mighty creatures. His eyes glint with a fanatical fervor, reflecting his zeal for the dragon-kind he venerates.

Nogi is fervent in his worship of dragons, preaching their superiority and the inevitable triumph of their might. His battle cry, "Glory to the Burning Ones! May their mighty fangs devour all foes!" underscores his belief in the dragons' supremacy and his role as their devoted zealot. Nogi's dragon transformation in battle symbolizes his aspiration to embody the very essence of the creatures he worships, becoming a conduit for their power.
